bridge-type.label: Google Drive Account
bridge-type.description: Connection to a Google Drive account. Login is done with a device code on google.com/device.

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: OAuth client ID of type "TVs and Limited Input devices" from the Google Cloud Console.

parameter.name: clientSecret
parameter.label: Client Secret
parameter.description: OAuth client secret belonging to the client ID.

parameter.name: quotaRefresh
parameter.label: Quota Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in minutes for reading the storage quota. 0 disables it.

thing-type.label: Backup Upload
thing-type.description: Watches the local backup folder and uploads new backups to a Google Drive folder.

parameter.name: sourceFolder
parameter.label: Source Folder
parameter.description: Local folder containing the backups. Empty means the default openHAB backup folder (userdata/backup).

parameter.name: filePattern
parameter.label: File Pattern
parameter.description: Glob pattern of the backup files to upload.

parameter.name: targetFolder
parameter.label: Target Folder
parameter.description: Name of the folder in Google Drive. It is created if it does not exist.

parameter.name: retentionCount
parameter.label: Backups to Keep
parameter.description: Number of backups kept in Google Drive. Older ones are removed. 0 keeps all.

parameter.name: retentionMode
parameter.label: Removal Mode
parameter.description: How old backups are removed from Google Drive.

parameter.name: autoUpload
parameter.label: Automatic Upload
parameter.description: Upload new backups automatically. If disabled, uploads only happen on command.

parameter.name: stableSeconds
parameter.label: Stable Time
parameter.description: Seconds a file size must stay unchanged before the file is considered complete.

parameter.name: uploadExistingOnStart
parameter.label: Upload Existing on Start
parameter.description: On start, upload local backups that are not yet in Google Drive.

parameter.name: deleteLocalAfterUpload
parameter.label: Delete Local After Upload
parameter.description: Delete the local file after the upload has been verified.

channel-type.label: Storage Used
channel-type.description: Storage used in the Google account

channel-type.label: Storage Total
channel-type.description: Total storage of the Google account (empty if unlimited)

channel-type.label: Login Code
channel-type.description: Code to enter on google.com/device. Empty when logged in.

channel-type.label: Upload Now
channel-type.description: ON uploads the newest local backup now

channel-type.label: Last Upload
channel-type.description: Time of the last successful upload

channel-type.label: Last File
channel-type.description: Name of the last uploaded file

channel-type.label: Last Size
channel-type.description: Size of the last uploaded file

channel-type.label: Backups in Drive
channel-type.description: Number of backups in the Google Drive folder

channel-type.label: Last Error
channel-type.description: Last error message, empty after a successful upload

channel-type.label: Upload Event
channel-type.description: Triggered when an upload starts, succeeds or fails
